name: smwgraphics-summer-hammer-time-beach-and-cave
title: Summer Hammer Time - Beach and Cave
description:
Handdrawn beach and cave tileset I originally made for my CLDC 2016 entry, named Summer Hammer Time. Contains FG, BG, Layer 3 graphics, tilemap and an ExAnimation GFX file to be used with the beach BG.

Recommended to use Lui37's "Move Layer 3 to subscreen fix" patch as well, unless you want your status bar to go behind layers 1 and 2. Or use a sprite status bar.

Nope Edit: Very minor fixes to sample levels; unused palette rows were wiped out, added them back in to save users a step in inserting these. The animated tiles in the beach background were set to slots so they would change animation on the same frame.
